title: PluginProcessor processBlock wiring - ScopedNoDenormals, smoothed reads, engine.process, meter push, latency reporting, CMakeLists
description:
Sole PluginProcessor and CMakeLists.txt owner for phase c. Wire ShredDoubleEngine into the live process path and register new sources/tests.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp phase-a spine (APVTS, prepareToPlay, processBlock stub, bus layout, latency stubs)
- Source/DSP/ShredDoubleEngine.h public API from c.1
- Source/StateManager.* masterSeed / reroll()
- CMakeLists.txt current target_sources and test target from phases a/b
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §§4.8–4.10, 5–7, 11

Implement:
1. PluginProcessor members: ShredDoubleEngine engine (or unique_ptr constructed in ctor without audio-thread alloc later).
2. prepareToPlay: engine.prepare(sampleRate, samplesPerBlock, latencyMode from APVTS); engine.seed(state masterSeed); setLatencySamples(engine.getLatencySamples()); updateHostDisplay if needed.
3. processBlock:
   - juce::ScopedNoDenormals at top
   - clear spare output channels
   - read smoothed parameters: crossover/monoXover coeffs per block; humanRate/tightness → engine block setters; spreads, pans, width, mix, outTrim smoothed and applied (per-sample where spec §6 requires)
   - if latencyMode or voiceCount changed vs previous: engine.setLatencyMode / setVoiceCount; setLatencySamples; updateHostDisplay on mode switch
   - engine.process on channel pointers (mono→stereo and stereo→stereo layouts already constrained)
   - final meter path is inside engine; ensure bypass uses true-bypass/delayed path consistent with tests
4. Expose engine/meter accessors needed by editor later (getCorrelation, drift atomics) without blocking.
5. Propagate StateManager Re-roll / setState masterSeed into engine.seed(newSeed) on message thread — never std::random_device inside processBlock.
6. CMakeLists.txt ONLY additive registration:
   - plugin target_sources: Source/DSP/MeterTap.cpp Source/DSP/ShredDoubleEngine.cpp
   - test target sources: tests/SeedingTests.cpp tests/EngineTests.cpp (files created by c.4/c.5)
   - do not delete phase b DSP/test entries; do not add AU

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Modify only PluginProcessor.h/.cpp and CMakeLists.txt.
acceptance_criteria: PluginProcessor owns/uses ShredDoubleEngine and calls engine.prepare in prepareToPlay and engine.process in processBlock
Smoothed APVTS parameters drive engine setters (voiceCount, spreads, humanRate, tightness, monoXover, pans, width, mix, outTrim, latencyMode, bypass)
setLatencySamples is called with engine.getLatencySamples() and updateHostDisplay runs on latency mode switch
masterSeed is applied via engine.seed from prepareToPlay/state/Re-roll paths without random_device in processBlock
CMakeLists.txt registers Source/DSP/MeterTap.cpp and Source/DSP/ShredDoubleEngine.cpp on the plugin target
CMakeLists.txt registers tests/SeedingTests.cpp and tests/EngineTests.cpp on the existing test target
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/ShredDoubleEngine.* or MeterTap.* bodies (owned by c.1/c.2)
modify Source/PluginEditor.* or StateManager.* beyond what is strictly required — prefer processor-only seed hooks
modify tests/** file bodies (owned by c.4/c.5) — CMake registration only
modify the eight reused ShredWidth DSP/GUI files
add AU format or FetchContent test frameworks

allowed: SmoothedValue or APVTS raw+manual smoothers consistent with phase-a processor style
value-tree listener or explicit editor/StateManager callback into processor.seedEngine
forbidden: allocate engine-owned DSP buffers inside processBlock
